items.body:

- #channel has been revised allowing members to now make their own post advertising items they may have or crafting they are offering.

items.title: __**Org News**__
items.body:
SDAS STAR CITIZEN CALENDAR
Stay synced with the ’Verse
Some Dudes and a Spaceship now has its own live Star Citizen calendar.
The SDAS Star Citizen Calendar keeps our org events, weekly activities, and important Star Citizen dates in one place. Subscribe once, and the calendar updates automatically as new events are scheduled or dates change.
No spreadsheets. No hunting through Discord. No “wait, was that this Wednesday or next Wednesday?”
Just open your calendar and see what’s coming.
WHAT’S ON IT
The calendar automatically pulls together:
* [SDAS] Org Events from Discord Scheduled Events
* [PATCH] LIVE Patch dates
* [PTU] PTU / EPTU dates
* [CIG] Major dated Star Citizen events and announc

**Some Dudes and a Spaceship officially has its own website!**

What started as a group of dudes looking for good company and adventures in the 'verse continues to grow, and now we've got a place on the web to call our own!

Our website serves as the **official online home of Some Dudes and a Spaceship**, giving our organization a presence outside of Discord and helping more Star Citizen players discover our community.
